Agent Name: Poetry_Expert
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Poetry_Expert incorrectly identified the stanza number based on a flawed visual analysis of the provided text. In the text retrieved from the Poetry Foundation, the indentation is actually present in the **second** stanza (lines like "tapping hidden graces", "from his smile", "nor have we felt his lack", "except in the one thing", "that when he came home", "each night", "his presence seemed a monster", "moving through the yards", "of our sleep", "restoring green to what had been", "a summertime"). The expert mistakenly claimed the indentation was in the third stanza and even misidentified the specific indented lines within that stanza ("and becomes less" and "until there is nothing left" are not indented in the provided text; they are left-aligned). This led to the final incorrect answer of "Stanza 3" instead of the correct "Stanza 2".
